FAQ

A few helpful answers.

Understand these pages and prepare for your next step.

Does reading this website create a lawyer-client relationship?

No. These are general information pages. Representation requires an agreement with a lawyer who accepts the matter.

Is there an office in every community listed?

No office is implied by a community guide. Confirm the location and format of an appointment directly with the professional you choose.

What should I share in a first enquiry?

Start with the broad topic, any important dates and your contact preferences. Ask how to send documents securely before sharing sensitive records.

Can I arrange a remote appointment?

Contact Kostyantyn to confirm appointment arrangements. Whether a matter can be handled remotely depends on the task, identification and signing requirements.

Does an enquiry stop a deadline?

Do not assume so. If your papers include a deadline or hearing date, seek prompt help and confirm any required action with the appropriate professional or office.

Which languages are available for appointments?

Appointments are available in English, Ukrainian and Russian. The French website is informational and does not imply that French-language representation is offered.

BEFORE YOU REACH OUT

Clear answers.
A simpler first step.

More questions & answers →
How do I request an appointment?

Call (289) 888-5878 or send a short enquiry to Kostyantyn Mykhalchenko. Include the general topic, any important dates and your preferred appointment language. The practice will confirm availability and whether it can assist.

What will legal services cost?

Ask the practice for the proposed scope, fee arrangement and any additional costs before agreeing to proceed. This website does not publish a fee schedule or promise a free consultation.

Can I get help outside Halifax?

Kostyantyn serves clients across Nova Scotia. Confirm the appointment location and format directly with the practice. Community guides do not indicate branch offices.

Which languages are available?

Appointments are available in English, Ukrainian and Russian. French pages provide information; they do not indicate French-language representation.
